summary: Improve HRIS data quality, transaction controls and workforce reporting through practical exercises. Review the course and enrol.
lede: HRIS training helps HR administrators, analysts and payroll coordinators manage employee data and routine HR transactions accurately. Participants map employee-data lifecycles, assess record quality, design transaction and payroll-input checks, review role-based access, and connect workforce indicators to their source records. Exercises also cover issue analysis and preparing an improvement plan and reporting brief.
audienceIntro: HRIS training suits professionals who maintain employee data, coordinate HR transactions or use workforce information to support HR and payroll decisions.
modules: HRIS Service Metrics and Issue Analysis
prerequisites: Recommended: familiarity with employee records, HR administration or payroll processes. No coding is required. Exercises use Excel, so bring a laptop with Excel installed or accessible.
